title: Harambee Stars Draw 1-1 With Eritrea in AFCON 2027 Opener
desc: Harambee Stars were held 1-1 by Eritrea at Nyayo Stadium after Ryan Ogam scored a late equaliser in Kenya’s AFCON 2027 qualifier.
content:
Harambee Stars began their 2027 Africa Cup of Nations qualifying campaign with a 1-1 draw against Eritrea at Nyayo National Stadium on Saturday, September 26.

Kenya fell behind in the first half before Belgium-based forward Ryan Ogam rescued a point with a late equaliser, denying Eritrea victory in Nairobi.

Eritrea took the lead in the 35th minute after Nahom Girmai capitalised on a defensive error involving Manzur Okwaro before finishing from the edge of the box. The goal left Kenya chasing the game for much of the afternoon.

Harambee Stars created opportunities to get back into the contest, but Eritrea's goalkeeper Malik Abdulrahman made several saves to keep the visitors ahead.

Kenya eventually found its breakthrough late in the match. Substitute Ben Stanley Omondi delivered a cross from the right, with Ogam reacting quickly to finish and make it 1-1.

The result comes after a difficult week for the national team. Harambee Stars' preparations were disrupted by a dispute over unpaid allowances, with players having declined to train earlier in the week. The team eventually held its first full collective training session on Friday, just a day before the Eritrea match.

Despite the draw, Kenya's participation in the qualifiers is not about securing its own place at the 2027 tournament. As one of the three co-hosts alongside Uganda and Tanzania, Kenya has already secured automatic qualification. CAF has nevertheless included the hosts in the qualifying competition to provide competitive matches ahead of the tournament.

The Group D campaign will still determine which other team joins the three hosts at AFCON 2027. South Africa, Guinea and Eritrea are competing for the remaining qualification place from the group.

For coach Benni McCarthy, the draw provides another competitive outing to assess his squad as Kenya builds towards next year's continental tournament. Harambee Stars will next face Guinea in Conakry on October 1.
